# `silk/toml_codec`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

Static contracts for converting common Silk values to and from TOML values.

## When to use

Use [`TomlCodec.writeOne`](#declaration-73696c6b2f746f6d6c5f636f6465633a3a546f6d6c436f6465632e77726974654f6e65) to write a typed value after a key and separator. Use
[`TomlCodec.decodeOne`](#declaration-73696c6b2f746f6d6c5f636f6465633a3a546f6d6c436f6465632e6465636f64654f6e65) on a parsed value for allocation-free types, or
[`TomlCodec.deserializeOne`](#declaration-73696c6b2f746f6d6c5f636f6465633a3a546f6d6c436f6465632e646573657269616c697a654f6e65) for an owned string.

Import as `TomlCodec` with `import silk.toml_codec { TomlCodec }`.

Public declarations: 4.
